CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.remember_guest_link_vault_save(p_actor uuid, p_album uuid, p_ciphertext text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF p_ciphertext IS NULL OR length(p_ciphertext)>1000 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM remember.webmasters w JOIN remember.albums a ON a.owner_user_id=w.user_id WHERE w.user_id=p_actor AND a.id=p_album) THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 INSERT INTO remember.guest_link_vault(album_id,ciphertext) VALUES(p_album,p_ciphertext) ON CONFLICT(album_id) DO UPDATE SET ciphertext=excluded.ciphertext;
 RETURN true;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.remember_photo_approval_readiness(p_album uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'albumExists',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM remember.albums a WHERE a.id=p_album),
 'readyPhotos',(SELECT count(*) FROM remember.album_photos p WHERE p.album_id=p_album AND p.state='ready'),
 'legacyPhotos',(SELECT count(*) FROM remember.album_photos p WHERE p.album_id=p_album AND p.state='ready' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM remember.photo_approval_queue q WHERE q.photo_id=p.id)),
 'pendingPhotos',(SELECT count(*) FROM remember.photo_approval_queue q WHERE q.album_id=p_album AND q.decision='pending'),
 'globalMode',COALESCE((SELECT mode FROM remember.security_feature_flags WHERE feature_key='photo_approval'),'OFF'),
 'testEligible',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM remember.security_test_eligibility e WHERE e.album_id=p_album AND e.feature_key='photo_approval'),
 'albumOptIn',COALESCE((SELECT require_photo_approval FROM remember.security_album_settings s WHERE s.album_id=p_album),false),
 'effective',public.remember_security_effective_feature_read(p_album,'photo_approval')
 )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.remember_photo_quarantine_claim(p_photo uuid, p_album uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare v_key text; v_token uuid;
begin
 select p.object_key into v_key
 from remember.photo_approval_queue q join remember.album_photos p on p.id=q.photo_id and p.album_id=q.album_id
 where q.photo_id=p_photo and q.album_id=p_album and q.decision='rejected'
 and q.decided_at<=now()-interval '72 hours' and p.state='ready'
 for update of q;
 if not found then return jsonb_build_object('claimed',false); end if;
 insert into remember.photo_quarantine_purge_claims(photo_id,claimed_at,claim_token)
 values(p_photo,now(),gen_random_uuid())
 on conflict(photo_id) do update set claimed_at=excluded.claimed_at,claim_token=excluded.claim_token
 where remember.photo_quarantine_purge_claims.claimed_at < now()-interval '30 minutes'
 returning claim_token into v_token;
 if v_token is null then return jsonb_build_object('claimed',false); end if;
 return jsonb_build_object('claimed',true,'objectKey',v_key,'claimToken',v_token);
end $function$

functions.name: remember_photo_quarantine_expired_read
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.remember_photo_quarantine_expired_read()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('photoId',x.photo_id,'albumId',x.album_id,'objectKey',x.object_key,'expiresAt',x.expires_at) order by x.decided_at),'[]'::jsonb)
 from (
  select q.photo_id,q.album_id,p.object_key,q.decided_at,q.decided_at+interval '72 hours' as expires_at
  from remember.photo_approval_queue q
  join remember.album_photos p on p.id=q.photo_id and p.album_id=q.album_id
  left join remember.photo_quarantine_purge_claims c on c.photo_id=q.photo_id
  where q.decision='rejected' and q.decided_at<=now()-interval '72 hours' and p.state='ready'
  and (c.photo_id is null or c.claimed_at<now()-interval '30 minutes')
  order by q.decided_at
  limit 50
 ) x
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.remember_security_webmaster_flags_read(p_actor uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_flags jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF p_actor IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM remember.webmasters WHERE user_id=p_actor)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'webmaster_required' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('feature',v.feature_key,'mode',coalesce(f.mode,'OFF')) ORDER BY v.feature_key),'[]'::jsonb)
 INTO v_flags
 FROM (VALUES ('verified_guest_email'),('photo_approval'),('guest_reports'),('report_notifications'),('slideshow_pause'),('quota_notifications')) v(feature_key)
 LEFT JOIN remember.security_feature_flags f ON f.feature_key=v.feature_key;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('features',v_flags,'readOnly',true);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.remember_test_stale_uploads_read()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_result jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF auth.role() IS DISTINCT FROM 'service_role' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'service_role_required' USING ERRCODE='42501';
 END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
  'photoId',p.id,'albumId',p.album_id,'objectKey',p.object_key,
  'state',p.state,'reservedUntil',p.reservation_expires_at,
  'createdAt',p.created_at,
  'digestHex',CASE WHEN p.content_sha256 IS NOT NULL THEN encode(p.content_sha256,'hex') ELSE NULL END
 ) ORDER BY p.created_at), '[]'::jsonb)
 INTO v_result
 FROM remember.album_photos p
 WHERE p.state IN ('reserved','uploading')
 AND p.reservation_expires_at < now()-interval '1 hour';
 RETURN v_result;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.remember_webmaster_admin_history(p_actor uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_rows jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF p_actor IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM remember.webmasters WHERE user_id=p_actor)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'webmaster_required' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('action',a.action,'actor',coalesce(actor.email,'Okänt konto'),'target',coalesce(target.email,'Okänt konto'),'at',a.occurred_at) ORDER BY a.occurred_at DESC),'[]'::jsonb)
 INTO v_rows FROM (SELECT * FROM remember.webmaster_admin_audit ORDER BY occurred_at DESC LIMIT 30) a
 LEFT JOIN auth.users actor ON actor.id=a.actor_id
 LEFT JOIN auth.users target ON target.id=a.target_id;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('history',v_rows);
END $function$
